Core watch criteria & status definitions

Core watch: top three in team total points or assists from this regular season’s records received before tipoff, with at least three verified team games and player appearances. Only an explicit Out report establishes listed absence. Not starting, no injury listing, roster Active or no minutes yet does not establish availability. An appearance and later Out report are both retained; no postgame absence reason is inferred.

Player stats use this regular season’s appearances recorded before tipoff; unrecorded games are excluded. FG% uses total makes / total attempts. Missing records or no attempts stay unknown. Original injury timestamps still govern freshness; post-tipoff receipts never backfill Preview.
